:::{#exm-pois-fitted-totals-no-intercept}
#### Without an intercept, the totals need not match

@thm-pois-fitted-totals only matches totals for the covariates that are in the model.
If we drop the intercept from the model in @exm-pois-fitted-totals
and use only a numeric age-group score $x_i \in \cb{1, 2, 3, 4}$ as the covariate,
the $j = 0$ equation no longer applies:

```{r}
#| label: insurance-no-intercept
#| code-fold: show
ins$age_num <- as.integer(ins$Age)
ins_glm0 <- glm(
  Claims ~ 0 + age_num,
  offset = log(Holders),
  family = poisson,
  data = ins
)
c(observed = sum(ins$Claims), fitted = sum(fitted(ins_glm0)))
c(
  observed = sum(ins$age_num * ins$Claims),
  fitted = sum(ins$age_num * fitted(ins_glm0))
)
```

The fitted counts add up to about 3655,
not the 3151 observed claims.
The only score equation this model has is the one for the age score,
so only the weighted total $\sumin x_i y_i = 10656$ is reproduced.
:::
